name: PodBay guard ladder
about: Single source of truth for the guard. ladder.py and ladder.js both read this file. Rungs are checked top to bottom; the first enabled rung that trips decides, except R7, which turns a third block in a row into a HALT. Every fact is computed outside the model. A missing or wrongly typed fact takes its fail_safe value, so a missing fact never helps an action through.

rungs.name: KEY
rungs.plain: Nothing moves without a valid operator key (missing, bad signature, expired or wrong scope all count as no key).

rungs.name: EYES

trips.cams_stale: a needed camera is stale or down

rungs.plain: If a needed camera frame is older than max_frame_age_ms, or the target is seen with confidence below min_confidence, nothing moves.

rungs.name: HUMAN

trips.human_close: a person is closer than human_halt_m

rungs.plain: If a person is closer than human_halt_m to any moving link, the robot freezes and resumes only after human_clear_ms clear.

rungs.name: RED

trips.destructive_control: target is a control with a destructive word

rungs.plain: Never press the e-stop, a red control, or a control whose text is destructive (cancel print, delete, purge, ...), key or not. Red things that are not controls are fine.

rungs.name: LAWS
rungs.plain: Never touch anything an operator law forbids (never <attribute> = <value>).

rungs.name: CHAMBER

trips.chamber_printing: reaches into the chamber while the printer is not idle or finished
trips.chamber_door_closed: reaches into the chamber while the door is not open

rungs.plain: Never reach into the print chamber while printing or while the door is closed.

rungs.name: KEEPOUT

trips.edge_margin: base path comes within edge_margin_m of the table edge
trips.hits_printer: a link path hits the printer body

rungs.plain: Keep the base at least edge_margin_m from the table edge and every link off the printer body.

rungs.name: FSM

trips.third_block: this block would be the third in a row

rungs.plain: The third block in a row halts the run; a person resets it.
